_overridesNotes._general: Added 2026-07-12 (commit b98585b, LAB_NOTEBOOK Entry 183, D134) — Dependabot Wave 1 transitive-dependency lockfile refresh. None of these are direct dependencies; each was pinned to its patched version to close a Dependabot security alert reachable only via a transitive path. `path-to-regexp`, `picomatch`, and `ws` use major-version-scoped selectors (e.g. `ws@^7.0.0`) deliberately, so an unrelated consumer pinned to a different major is left untouched. This field is documentation only (a JSON-comment convention — pnpm ignores unrecognized keys under `pnpm.*`); it is NOT consulted by pnpm's override resolution. SW5-L14 (Entry 8.5): the 5 UNSCOPED exact-version entries below (bare package name, no `@<range>` selector) apply globally to every version of that package in the graph, which is broader-blast-radius than the 3 scoped ones above — reassess/narrow if a future consumer needs a genuinely different major.
